headline: Review of the proposed Palmer Renewable Energy Biomass Power Plant, including legal proceedings, environmental and public health concerns, and community impacts.
summary: The meeting will review the current status of the proposed Palmer Renewable Energy Biomass Power Plant. The review will cover pending legal proceedings, environmental and public health concerns, and potential impacts on the East Springfield community.
